en.title: EU Accessibility Act Implementation Lagging; MTA Settles Subway Elevator Access Lawsuit
en.summary: One year after the European Accessibility Act took effect, many businesses remain non‑compliant, highlighting ongoing challenges in implementing accessibility standards. In New York, a class‑action settlement with the MTA requires better signage and alerts for subway elevator outages to improve access for disabled riders. Additionally, new all‑terrain wheelchairs, a mobile accessibility center in Missouri, an accessible dock in Tennessee, and a guide on accessible documentation were announced.

zh-TW.title: 歐洲無障礙法一年後企業仍未達標
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲無障礙法實施已滿一年，但許多企業仍未符合無障礙標準，顯示落實挑戰依然嚴峻。紐約地鐵與殘障倡導者達成和解，將改善電梯故障時的標誌、廣播與警報，提升殘障乘客可及性。此外，全地形輪椅讓州立公園更易進入，密蘇里州首輛流動無障礙中心上路，以及一則來自日本的推文討論國會無障礙進展。
